description: This file defines the 'Notebooks' class which manages notebook entities in the Notesnook project, including CRUD operations, hierarchy management, and related database interactions.

classes.name: Notebooks
classes.description: Class managing notebook entities, including creation, retrieval, hierarchy, and deletion operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new notebook, merging with existing data if necessary.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a filter for all non-deleted, non-trashed notebooks.

methods.name: pinned
methods.description: Returns a filter for pinned notebooks.

methods.name: pin
methods.description: Sets the pinned state for specified notebooks.

methods.name: totalNotes
methods.description: Calculates total notes within specified notebooks, including sub-notebooks.

methods.name: notes
methods.description: Retrieves note IDs within specified notebooks.

methods.name: breadcrumbs
methods.description: Retrieves the hierarchy path (breadcrumbs) for a given notebook.

methods.name: notebook
methods.description: Fetches a specific notebook by ID if not trashed.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a notebook exists by ID.

methods.name: moveToTrash
methods.description: Moves notebooks and their sub-notebooks to trash.

methods.name: parentId
methods.description: Retrieves the parent ID of a notebook.
